mainEntity.name: What is the TONTON Pro Snake-Scale MMA Fight Short?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a custom MMA and No-Gi grappling shorts development reference with a scale-pattern shell, hook-and-loop fly, internal drawcord, stretch crotch gusset and curved side openings. Buyers can develop their own colors, logo positions, sizing and labels.

mainEntity.name: Which colors and SKUs are available as references?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stealth Black: TT-MMA-SS01-BLK; Tactical Grey: TT-MMA-SS01-GRY; Frost White: TT-MMA-SS01-WHT; Midnight Navy: TT-MMA-SS01-NVY. These website reference SKUs identify color options, not ready-stock inventory. Grey currently has detail photographs rather than a complete front view.

mainEntity.name: What are the shell and gusset materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied brief specifies a 100% micro-polyester shell and an 88% polyester / 12% spandex stretch-knit gusset. Confirm exact GSM, material records and performance on the selected sample before bulk production.

mainEntity.name: Is the snake-scale effect jacquard or sublimation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The photographs establish the visible scale-like pattern. They do not determine whether it is jacquard, sublimation or another finish. Approve the chosen material and decoration process with a swatch and sample.

mainEntity.name: Can these shorts be used for MMA or No-Gi BJJ competition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Review the actual garment against the organizer’s current equipment rules, including pockets, hardware, exposed hook-and-loop and drawcords. This product page does not certify competition approval.

mainEntity.name: Are the waistband and seams guaranteed never to slip or tear?

acceptedAnswer.text: No measured test is supplied for absolute non-slip, tear-proof or lifetime durability claims. Check closure security, elastic recovery, seam strength and mobility with a physical fit sample.

mainEntity.name: Can a private-label brand customize the design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Discuss colors, scale artwork, waist tab, leg emblem, inner labels, pattern dimensions and packaging. Confirm artwork permissions and the final construction before quotation.

mainEntity.name: How do MOQ, mixed sizes and sampling work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected custom projects start at 10 pieces; minimums per style, design and colorway require confirmation. Send a size allocation and measurement chart. The advertised 3–7 day sample target starts after artwork and details are confirmed; material sourcing, patterns and revisions may extend it.
